page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable, text-only review guidance. Attach a skill to any number of agents.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create a skill, or import one from a Markdown file or a .zip archive.

card.agents: {count, plural, =0 {not attached} one {# agent} other {# agents}}
card.toggle: Enable or disable this skill for every agent

drawer.rendered: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
drawer.notAttached: Not attached to any agent yet. Attach it from an agent’s Skills tab.
drawer.deleteConfirm: Delete skill “{name}”? It is removed from every agent that uses it ({agents}). This cannot be undone.
drawer.deleteConfirmUnused: Delete skill “{name}”? This cannot be undone.

trust.notice: This skill was imported. Its text is someone else’s instructions and goes into the prompt of every agent it is enabled on. Read it before enabling.

editor.notFound: Skill not found — it may have been deleted.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.nameHint: A kebab-case slug, unique in the workspace. Shown in the prompt as the block name.

nameErrors.format: Use lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, e.g. test-coverage-gaps.

config.descriptionHint: This is the skill’s interface: the reviewer reads it to decide when the skill applies. Write it as a directive — “Use when … Flag … Do not …”.
config.descriptionPlaceholder: Use when a PR changes … Flag …
config.bodyHint: Markdown. Text only — skills cannot run tools, scripts or code. Saving a change creates a new version.

preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
preview.blockHint: The exact text this skill adds to an agent’s prompt (shown with the saved version).

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every change to name, description, type or body is saved as a snapshot. Open “Changes” to see what a version changed. Restoring creates a new version — history is never rewritten.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? This creates v{next} with that content.

diff.label: Changes in v{to}
diff.unchanged: {count, plural, one {⋯ # unchanged line} other {⋯ # unchanged lines}}

import.title: Import a skill
import.subtitle: Upload a Markdown file or a .zip archive. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.trustTitle: You are importing someone else’s instructions
import.trustBody: A skill’s text goes straight into your agents’ prompts. Only the Markdown text is imported: scripts, tool permissions and other files are dropped and never run. Read the skill before you save it.
import.ignoredTitle: Not imported — never decompressed or executed
import.nameConflict: A skill with this name already exists — rename it before saving.
import.confirm: I’ve read this skill and accept its instructions into my agents’ prompts.
import.enableNow: Enable now (otherwise it is saved disabled)
import.savedToast: Imported “{name}”{enabled, select, true {} other { (disabled until you enable it)}}.
